messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: P0 — embedder-eu service — high 5xx rate (INC-6842) — https://pagerduty.com/INC-6842
pagerbot: trigger details: service=embedder-eu, region=eu-west1, symptom=5xx spike + latency, window=3m, error_rate=~5.8%
sana: taking this — oncall here 👋
sana: quick question — is this hitting Dedicated or Hosted?
kevin: looks like hosted API traffic, routed to the eu pool, small subset of customers affected
sana: running quick logs: `kubectl logs -n inference deploy/embedder-eu --tail 200 | grep ERROR` — seeing KV cache OOM + eviction thrash entries
sana: ops-runbook-bot: please pull runbook for KV cache OOM mitigation
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: embedder-kv-oom — steps: 1) increase cache memory, 2) rotate pool, 3) fallback to quantized model variant, 4) notify CS. Link: https://runbooks.internal/embedder-kv-oom
sana: applying replica scale +2 (patch id: scale-4442) and bump kv_cache_max to 1.2GB, monitoring metrics
maria: CS FYI — I'm seeing a handful of customers report failed embeddings in support queue, any estimate on impact?
jordan: quick metric: peak error rate ~0.8% of total requests in the window, sustained 0.5-0.9% for ~4m, retries mostly succeeded
sana: customer-impact summary: small percent of requests had transient 5xx; no persistent data loss; retries succeeded for most customers — recommend short PSA + note about mitigation
kevin: request: schedule handoff to me for the 15:00 UTC shift so I can monitor during next busy window
sana: handing off to kevin at 15:00 UTC — leaving notes in the incident timeline
kevin: ack — I'll take over at 15:00 UTC and run a canary to confirm stability
sana: note: root cause seems to be malformed input vectors causing KV growth and eviction thrash; mitigated by eviction tuning + rolling restart of affected pods
kevin: on takeover I'll run a small load test and validate error_rate <0.3% for 10m before closing
maria: prepping customer comm draft: short explanation + mitigation + ETA. Will ping for review
sana: current status: error rate down to ~0.2% and latency returning to baseline :thumbsup:
kevin: running canary now, will report in 10m
pagerbot: INC-6842 update: acknowledged by sana, handoff scheduled to kevin, mitigation in progress
kevin: canary stable at 0.15% errors over 12m, metrics look good — leaving 30m watch and then will close PD if no regression
maria: customer note sent to impacted accounts (CS-PR#1123)
sana: thanks all — added follow-up tasks: input sanitization test + CI for vector shapes, assign to eng-ml (ENG-4321)
jordan: ENG-4321 created and assigned to eng-ml squad
kevin: final: will close incident after 30m steady state, otherwise reopen and escalate
maria: will follow up with customers if anything changes
incidentbot: INC-6842 status: mitigated, handoff to kevin, monitoring window active
kevin: closing loop — metrics healthy for 30m, marking incident resolved in PD, will follow up with a short postmortem
sana: nice work team ❤️
kevin: leaving final note: action item — add input sanitization + eviction thresholds to canary profile (postmortem/ENG-4321)
maria: closing CS loop — customers informed
pagerbot: INC-6842 marked resolved (auto-close after confirmation)
